blocks.text: Procedures for work on gas pipeline compressor stations, including compressor CS-3 and isolation valve GV-17. All hot work requires a hot-work permit.
Continuously monitor for flammable gas with a calibrated detector. Alarm thresholds are expressed as a percentage of the lower explosive limit (%LEL).

| Level | Threshold | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Low alarm | 10 %LEL | Investigate and ventilate |
| High alarm | 20 %LEL | Stop work, evacuate the exclusion zone |
| Trip | 40 %LEL | Automatic compressor shutdown |
Establish an exclusion zone around the work. For compressor CS-3 the exclusion-zone radius is 15 m during venting. For valve GV-17 operations the exclusion-zone radius is 8 m.

Obtain a hot-work permit before welding, grinding or any ignition source. Test the atmosphere, confirm it is below 10 %LEL, post a fire watch, and keep the permit on site. If gas is detected above 20 %LEL, stop work and contact your supervisor.
